Class MKCSlotScreenHook

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.MKCSlotScreenHook
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.inject.SlotScreenHook
public final class MKCSlotScreenHook extends Object implements com.trevorschoeny.menukit.inject.SlotScreenHook
MenuKit-Containers' implementation of MenuKit's neutral SlotScreenHook — the one place panel-hosted registered-slot input resolution plugs into MenuKit's library-owned screen dispatch (§0042). Registered with SlotScreenDispatcher.setHook at MKC client init.

The input limb only. A registered slot draws itself inline as a SlotElement on the panel pipeline, so this hook no longer renders anything and holds no presence list. Its sole job is hover/click resolution: fed by the live SlotElementRegistry (the set of panel ids that currently host a SlotElement), it asks MKCSlotInput which MKCSlot a screen point covers, so vanilla's getHoveredSlot routes hover/click to the registered slot rather than the vanilla slot beneath it — and eats clicks that land in a revealed panel's empty space (the gap-block backstop).

Client-only — every method runs on the render/input thread; the server never constructs this.
